what: Make the TUI's sources screen size with the terminal, keep the selected source and its evidence in view as the cursor moves, and show a broken source's whole error so what failed is visible.
why: The source-health walks C17 and C20 failed on the operator's host because the sources screen lost its cursor and cut NCC Group's error before its 404; the design is docs/work/source-health-screen/design.md.

criteria.given: the real TUI Model sized by a 188x51 WindowSizeMsg with the sources screen opened through its key and loaded with the operator host's set: 49 sources, eight of them with evidence lines (one broken carrying the real 404 error text below, error_count 6 and a next try; two empty; five dormant), flagged sources placed among the first, middle and last ten
criteria.when: j is pressed from the first source to the last, then k back to the first, the Model's full view rendered after every keypress
criteria.then: Failing first: at base, once the cursor passes the box's first rows the rendered view no longer holds the selected source's ▸ row, while j and k still move the cursor. After the change, every one of the 96 rendered views holds the ▸ marker on the row naming the selected source.

mutations.change: Pass list-mode key messages to the viewport again (the old viewport.Update in SourceModal.Update): some rendered view lacks the selected source's ▸ row.

criteria.given: the C1 Model, set and size
criteria.when: the cursor reaches each of the eight sources with evidence by j from the top and again by k from the bottom, the full view rendered at each
criteria.then: Failing first: at base the evidence of a selected source on the box's bottom row is cut or absent. After the change, every row of the selected source's evidence, as the sources screen wraps it, appears in the rendered view at each of the 16 stops.

mutations.change: Make windowStart keep only the source's first row in view: the selected broken source's last evidence row is missing when the cursor reaches it from above.

criteria.given: the C1 Model, set and size, where the broken source's stored error is the real text the RSS fetcher raised against a local server answering 404, as recorded in docs/work/source-health-screen/shape/real-404-error.txt and carried into a committed test fixture
criteria.when: the cursor is moved onto the broken source and the full view renders
criteria.then: Failing first: at base the evidence ends near 'Failed to fetch RSS feed' and the view lacks '404 Not Found'. After the change, the rendered view contains '404 Not Found' and no ESC, CR or LF byte from the error.

mutations.change: Restore the 60-rune cut on the error in failureEvidence: the view lacks '404 Not Found'.

criteria.given: the C1 Model, set and size, with the cursor on a healthy source near the bottom of the list
criteria.when: K is pressed and the resulting status message ('⚠ Nothing to keep: this source raises no warning' or the reply the real operation returns) is shown, then an error message longer than the box's width is set on the screen, the full view rendered after each
criteria.then: Failing first: a status or error message that wraps adds rows and pushes the selected row out of the box. After the change, both rendered views hold the selected source's ▸ row, the status bar occupies one row, and the rendered sources screen has the same number of rows as before the message.

mutations.change: Drop the one-row cut on the status message: the rendered screen gains rows and the row count assertion fails.

criteria.given: the C1 Model and set at 188x51
criteria.when: the sources screen and the help screen are each rendered
criteria.then: Failing first: at base the sources screen renders 45 columns wide whatever the terminal. After the change, both render the same width, the help screen's width at 188x51 (75 percent of 188, plus its border), and the sources screen's list shows more than 30 list rows when the cursor is on the first source.

criteria.given: the real TUI Model sized by a 60x30 WindowSizeMsg, the sources screen loaded with the C1 set
criteria.when: j is pressed from the first source to the last, the full view rendered after every keypress, and the cursor stops on the broken source
criteria.then: Failing first: wrapping the error by bytes with no split of a word longer than the width leaves a row wider than the list, so the frame wraps it onto rows the window never counted. After the change, every rendered line of the view is at most 60 columns wide, every rendered view holds the selected source's ▸ row, and at the broken source the view contains '404 Not Found'.

mutations.change: Wrap evidence with wrapTextWithPrefix instead of ansi.Wrap: at the broken source a rendered line exceeds the list width or a selected row is missing.

criteria.given: the C1 Model, set and size, with the cursor on the first source
criteria.when: 40 mouse wheel-down messages are sent, then 40 wheel-up messages, the full view rendered after each
criteria.then: Failing first: with the viewport gone and no wheel handling, the wheel does nothing. After the change, each wheel-down moves the cursor one source down and each wheel-up one source up, and every rendered view holds the selected source's ▸ row.

outOfScope.summary: A broken source's evidence repeats what its stored error carries, including the feed URL twice and httpx's documentation link, so a 404 takes about two rows at a 188-column terminal.

frequency.records: sources on the operator's daemon host whose stored state is broken (the inactive, error_count 5 row, NCC Group)

outOfScope.summary: The box follows the help screen's minimum of 20 rows, so on a terminal shorter than 28 rows it is taller than the terminal less 8, as the help screen already is.

frequency.command: the walk's pane size relayed in source-health#30 (188x51)

outOfScope.summary: A mouse wheel moves the cursor rather than scrolling the list past it.

frequency.reason: How the wheel behaves on this screen is a property of the design, not a case a use of prismis runs into.

outOfScope.summary: wrapTextWithPrefix and wrapText count bytes and never split a word longer than the width, so the reader cuts a long word (a URL in a summary) at the view's edge.

walks.when: after merge and deployment, the operator opens the sources screen in the TUI in their usual pane and steps j from the top to NCC Group and on to the last source
walks.then: The selected source is visible at every step, NCC Group can be selected, and K on it keeps it.

walks.when: with NCC Group selected on the deployed build
walks.then: Its evidence line shows the 404 (Client error '404 Not Found').

stakes: After every keypress, resize, reload, error or status message the selected source's row and every row of its evidence are inside the drawn window, at any terminal size.
Every row the list draws occupies exactly one terminal row; the window always draws as many list rows as its height holds while rows remain below it.
A broken source's evidence carries its whole stored error, control-stripped and flattened, wrapped to the screen's width, with no cut and no matching against its wording.
The sources screen sizes with the terminal by the help screen's rule, one function serving both.
The daemon, its stored columns and the API are unchanged; the main view's source list is unchanged.
